args.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost in production
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set, and passwordResetEmail (along with rollupText and scheduledExportEmail) builds its links from that value. In production, PUBLIC_URL appears to be unset or not reaching this module, so reset-password links point at localhost instead of the real public host.

Proposed fix: ensure PUBLIC_URL is set in the production environment/deploy config, and/or read the base URL from a validated config value (e.g. config.publicUrl) instead of defaulting silently to localhost, so misconfiguration fails loudly rather than producing broken links. This should restore correct links for password reset, weekly rollup, and scheduled export emails.
